title: Amethyst Otherside
description: It always seemed weird to me that the otherside disc is new-gen but it uses the old music disc texture. this pack changes that!
body: It always seemed weird to me that the otherside disc is new-gen but it uses the old music disc texture. this pack changes that! it takes insparation from discs like pigstep, creator, relic and it transforms the texture using to the corresponding update-added items (amethyst for here instance)
